{{Quote|I am Lelo-Vo and these are my words. I who would not replace the interpreters. Sixteen years debating. The Three screamed. The people begged. Sixteen years but the interpretation was true. Vision cannot be rushed.|Writings of Lelo-Vo|<ref name="Imp March of Time">{{TORcite|type=faction|Empire|March of Time|Voss}}</ref>}}
The '''Writings of Lelo-Vo''' were composed by a [[Voss Mystics|Voss Mystic]] named [[Lelo-Vo]] many years before his [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was discovered by the galactic society. The writings were etched on a pillar erected outside the [[Shrine of Healing]] in the [[Old Paths]]. A traveling hero recorded the writings and gave them to [[Ker-Na]].
